baseline.description: Re-pinned 2026-09-19 to a current green main commit. The prior pin (5021d36c, 2026-08-11) predates over a month of intentional feature and prompt/schema growth: #691 replaced the search_sessions tool with the sessions CLI, #695 added repo_map/ast_grep shell-comparison prompting, #693 renamed capabilities and moved self-configuration behind CLI routes, #698 added profile management, #700 lists configured MCP servers in the system prompt, #705 and #730 made spawn_background's real 1061-byte schema eager instead of a deferred stub, among ~120 other src/-touching commits. `runtime::tests::cold_start_prompt_composition_is_measured_by_component` tracks and accepts each of these deliberately (current cold start: prompt 13,408 bytes, tool definitions 24,574 bytes, schemas 13,938 bytes across 37 tools). That made the frozen pre-repin baseline look permanently cheaper on every ordinary-control gate's token/cost checks: the 2026-09-19 nightly (run #78) showed add-fn, distinct-failures-control, find-constant, and expected-diagnostic-failure-control all regressing input_tokens and cost_usd by roughly 2x-5x, failing on accumulated, unrelated architecture growth rather than a real regression, the same failure mode #539 caused for the prior pin. Re-pin periodically to keep the ordinary-control gates comparing against current architecture; the focused search-efficiency cases this baseline also anchors remain valid regardless of the pin date. The same nightly also caught a real candidate bug, unrelated to this re-pin: #643 (refactor(filesystem): use physical repository paths) started matching a grep_files path_pattern against the absolute disk path instead of a path relative to the search root, so a directory-anchored glob such as src/**/*.rs could never match (grep-files-nested-glob correctness 100% -> 0%; the same extra recovery call inflated repo-map-bounded's tool-call budget). That was fixed in code, with a regression test (runtime::tests::grep_tool_matches_directory_anchored_nested_glob_path_pattern), not by this re-pin. Fresh reference_evidence for this pin is left to the next scheduled nightly run rather than a manual live comparison here, per the eval's own guidance against running the full 25+ minute live-provider workflow outside its schedule.
